# Decision Log

Use this page for durable decisions that should shape future compilation, querying, and personal operating behavior.

## Decisions

| Date | Decision | Rationale | Review |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-05-24 | Keep the Knowledge Base simple: durable knowledge content lives in `raw/` and `wiki/`. | This preserves the Karpathy raw-source to compiled-wiki pattern and avoids folder sprawl. | Revisit only if the flat wiki becomes unmanageable. |
| 2026-05-24 | Treat AI, agents, and software as one major domain, not the whole vault identity. | The corpus now includes health, money, Canada policy, communication, philosophy, venture, and work. | Revisit after the next full curation pass. |
| 2026-05-24 | Store personal observations and experiments as typed raw files. | Personal experience should be evidence, while wiki pages remain maintained synthesis. | Revisit after several personal-source compiles. |
| 2026-05-24 | Use flat operational wiki pages for open loops, decisions, research leads, and claim review. | These are part of the second-brain interface and should compound like other wiki artifacts. | Revisit if operational pages become too large. |

## Decision note template

```yaml
source_type: decision_note
domain: health | leadership-work | venture | money | canada-policy | ai-software | knowledge-learning | communication | self-meaning | assurance
created: YYYY-MM-DD
needs_verification: false
```

Record:

- decision
- context
- options considered
- rationale
- expected review date
- related wiki pages
